scope: Four-method first-task/one-epoch efficiency comparison: new RanPAC/L2P/DualPrompt observations and immutable historical EASE Base64 reuse.

protocol.precision: Reuse _configure_ease_precision: FP32 parameters, no autocast, CUDA matmul TF32 off, cuDNN TF32 on, deterministic=True, benchmark=False.
protocol.algorithm_hyperparameters: Retain existing manifest learning rates and method-specific settings; L2P/DualPrompt batchwise_prompt=0. Record effective args including each method's native learning-rate scaling.

accuracy_policy.scope: Accuracy must be strictly greater than 20% as an abnormal-collapse guard for a ten-class, one-epoch pilot; predictions must match reported accuracy. This is not paper reproduction and does not apply EASE's twenty-epoch 1.5/3.0pp margins.

protocol.measurement_policy: Each method runs measurement, measurement, measurement+separate FLOPs in order. Only the three measurement passes enter median/min/max efficiency statistics. EASE is reused without a new experiment.

protocol_snapshot_scope: Captured at execution start; embedded preparation-status flags are historical. Current completion is represented by the top-level status and pilot_status.

flops.scope: Partial supported PyTorch operator estimate over initialization, train forward/backward, task-end prototypes, evaluation and diagnostic audits in this separate pass.
flops.limitations: Unsupported/fused operators, optimizer and linear algebra may be omitted; phase FLOPs are not attributed. Not training-only FLOPs. No backward x3 extrapolation.

summary.aggregation_scope: Three measurement passes only; FLOPs-pass time, memory and energy excluded.
summary.accuracy_scope: One-epoch pilot accuracy; the matched twenty-epoch 1.5/3.0pp margins do not apply.
